summary: Iteration 32 — Payment Receipt feature E2E verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (PAR-XXX auto-assign, receipt HTML fragments, PDF download via WeasyPrint, admin edit + accounts 403, payments/overview regression, transactions list, legacy backfill, doc reuse). Frontend: Customer Detail → Payment Tracking tab shows 'Receipt No.' column with PAR-001/003/005, green Receipt icon opens EditableDocumentDialog rendering the full receipt template (RRL header, address, www link, Invoice Number PAR-001, Received with thanks, A sum of Rupees, For Palm Altezze — Flat No., Towards, AUTHORISED SIGNATURE, Cheque/s subject to realisation). Toast 'Receipt PAR-001 ready' shown. Sidebar Payments nav (IndianRupee icon) loads /payments page (PaymentsPage.js) without errors. Dashboard PaymentStageCard renders the overdue summary tiles conditionally on stageOverdue.length > 0 (data-testid='overdue-customers-summary' + 'overdue-total-summary' present in code; not visible on test data because current stage has zero overdue customers).

ui_bugs.issue: Receipt template renders BOTH an 'Invoice Number: PAR-001' line (top-right) AND a separate 'Receipt No.' label whose value is blank. Looks duplicated/unfilled on the printed receipt. Either populate Receipt No. with the same PAR- value, or drop one of the two labels.

Tiles only render when stageOverdue.length > 0. On current test data (stage 'On Completion of Podium Slab 40%') no overdue customers exist so tiles are hidden. Spec wording 'now shows two prominent red summary tiles' suggests they should be visible at all times. Consider always rendering them (showing 0 / ₹0) so the user sees the metric even when there is no overdue.

action_items: LOW: In templates/payment_receipt.py, fill the 'Receipt No.' field with transaction.receipt_number (currently blank, duplicates Invoice Number row).
LOW: Consider always rendering the two overdue summary tiles in PaymentStageCard (show 0 / ₹0 when stageOverdue is empty) so the dashboard metric is consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: payments/routes.py:179-188 — receipt counter via $inc on db.settings is correct and atomic; works for legacy txns via _ensure_receipt_number in documents/routes.py.

documents/routes.py:299-364 — generate_payment_receipt correctly handles customer lookup by both id and customer_id, reuses existing GeneratedDocument (no duplicates), backfills receipt_number, stores transaction_id link.
documents/routes.py:230-246 — PUT /documents/html/{doc_id} blocks accounts role with 403 (verified). Admin edit confirmed to persist on subsequent GET.
WeasyPrint PDF generation tested: 200 OK, content-type application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes, >5KB payload.

PaymentStageCard.jsx:38 — the entire overdue block (including the 2 summary tiles) is gated behind stageOverdue.length > 0. If main agent wants the tiles to always show, hoist them out of this conditional.
PaymentsPage loads successfully with no 'customers.slice' or similar runtime errors. Sidebar IndianRupee nav item works.
DashboardLayout: 'Payments' nav rendered between Customers and Documents as specified.
seed_data_creation: Test transactions created on Ramya test lead during pytest were auto-cleaned via module-scoped teardown (DELETE /api/transactions and DELETE /api/documents). No residual TEST_ data left in DB.
